title: Closure scalar comparison on one shifted rational root line
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite subextension of its fixed algebraic closure, X and S Noetherian schemes, f:X→S qcqs, and ell invertible on X. Let R be a DiagonalRightDerived model for the E-coefficient direct image, whose functor and full universal cochain unit are canonical [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category, lem-diagonal-canonical-right-derived]. There exists an adjoint-normalized Endpoint [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-endpoints] from spRationalTwist X ell E to spQbarTwist X ell along the actual closure coefficient inclusion and closureLineMap [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-maps]. There also exists a full-unit-normalized RestrictionSquare [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars] from R to the canonical closure direct image, whose scalar mate is invertible on the rational root line in degree zero shifted by two. This asserts nothing about arbitrary unbounded objects and contains no diagonal arrow, trace, supported source, Diagram family or integration identity.

proof.text: Use the normalized derived endpoint of the closure root line. It applies on X with the given global invertibility hypothesis and contains exactly the prescribed closureLineMap.

The closure scalar inclusion is flat by the existing coefficient-colimit API, so its exact restriction preserves K-injectives. Use the actual derivedComapLowerStarIso. Its full-unit normalization follows by pasting the canonical right-derived composition and natural-isomorphism unit equations. Transport to R along hR, using hunit on every cochain complex. This gives a normalized RestrictionSquare.

The rational-line single complex shifted by two lies in D^{ge -2}. Package it as an object of the bounded-below derived category and apply the existing qcqs algebraic-closure direct-image comparison to the actual derivedPushHom. By construction the normalized square has derivedComapLowerStarIso as its isomorphism, so its mate is exactly this derivedPushHom. Thus the required component is invertible, with no claim about arbitrary unbounded inputs.

theorem diagonalClosure_lineComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(X, ⊤)))
    (R : DiagonalRightDerived
      (CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E.1) f))
    (hR : R.R =
      (CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E.1) f).rightDerivedFunctor)
    (hunit : IsCanonicalRightDerived
      (CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} E.1) f) R hR) :
    ∃ line : Endpoint (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl l E)
        (spRationalTwist X l E) (spQbarTwist X l) (closureLineMap l E X),
      ∃ square : RestrictionSquare (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl l E) f R
          (scalarRightDerived (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj.{u} l) f),
        IsIso ((square.mate (Profinite.padicSubfieldRingObjToPadicAlgCl l E)).app
          (((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (spRationalTwist X l E))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
